Privacy policy

This is a fixture. It collects nothing, stores nothing and shares nothing, which makes it the shortest honest privacy policy in the trade. The page exists because a site without one fails the trust checks, and a fixture that cannot pass those checks cannot prove they work.

Last updated 1 August 2026. Questions to hello@example.invalid.

What the server keeps

The access log records the requested page, the time, the browser's user agent and a truncated address. It exists to find broken pages and to tell a search engine crawler from a visitor. It is kept for thirty days and then deleted, and nothing in it is combined with anything else.

Cookies and analytics

This site sets no cookies of its own and loads no analytics or advertising scripts, so there is nothing to consent to and no banner asking you to. If that ever changes, this page changes first and the date below moves.

Your rights

Under the GDPR you may ask what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted. Given the above the answer is usually that we hold nothing, but ask and we will check the log for the period you name and tell you what is in it. Requests are answered within a week, by the person who does the baking, because there is nobody else to pass them to.

Ordering bread

Orders taken by telephone are written on paper at the counter and thrown away once the order has been collected. We keep no customer list and send no marketing of any kind, because we bake a fixed amount each morning and it sells. There is no account to create and nothing to unsubscribe from.

Data protection contact

Write to the address above, marked for the attention of the data protection contact, who is the same person who does the baking. There is no form, no ticketing system and no third party in between, which is the only advantage a business this small has over one with a compliance department.
